name: cw_burn_attacker
note: Rung-2 combat window, the H3 REVERSAL - the go-wide attack punished: an UNBLOCKED 2/2 Brute would deal 2, but P1 holds the Shock and answers in the post-declare window (P0 holds nothing and is never asked, C15). The attacker dies BEFORE the damage step and deals NOTHING (pinned engine law: a dead attacker's blockers - and it alone - deal no damage); P0's life stays 20. Re-pinned 2026-10-29 (V2): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the setup mana (formerly banked across two turns) is added as the combat window opens ('window_mana'), standing in for the lands tapped there (CR 605.3a).
